content:
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Kidney Transplant Referral QAPI Dashboard -- SHINYLIVE (browser-only) version
#
# Runs entirely in the web browser via WebR: no R install needed for viewers.
# It contains NO data. The viewer uploads either
#   - the raw export  KI_Referral_Details.csv, or
#   - the de-identified file  KI_Referral_Deidentified.csv  (from deidentify.R)
# and the data stays in their browser; nothing is sent to a server.
#
# DO NOT put any CSV in this folder: shinylive bundles everything in it.
# Build/preview with build_shinylive.R (one folder up).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(DT)

INSURANCE   <- "(4) Insurance issues"
BLUE  <- "steelblue"
CORAL <- "coral"

# --------------------------- data cleaning ---------------------------------

# Same payer grouping as Kidney_metrics.R (first match wins, same order)
clean_payer <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    str_detect(x, "UHC|United|UNITED")                  ~ "United Health Care",
    str_detect(x, "COMMUNITY")                          ~ "Community Health",
    str_detect(x, "BCBS|BLUE")                          ~ "Blue Cross Blue Shield",
    str_detect(x, "Wellcare|WELLCARE|AMBETTER|SUPERIOR") ~ "Centene",
    str_detect(x, "WELLPOINT")                          ~ "Wellpoint",
    str_detect(x, "AETNA")                              ~ "Aetna",
    str_detect(x, "HUMANA")                             ~ "Humana",
    str_detect(x, "MEDICARE PART")                      ~ "Medicare",
    str_detect(x, "CIGNA")                              ~ "Cigna",
    str_detect(x, "HEALTHSPRING")                       ~ "Health Spring",
    str_detect(x, "KELSEY")                             ~ "Kelsey Care",
    str_detect(x, "MEMORIAL")                           ~ "MH",
    is.na(x) | x == ""                                  ~ "Unknown",
    str_detect(x, "[0-9]")                              ~ "Other",
    TRUE                                                ~ x
  )
}

mdy2 <- function(x) as.Date(x, format = "%m/%d/%y")

last_line <- function(x) {
  vapply(strsplit(x, "\n", fixed = TRUE),
         function(s) if (length(s)) tail(s, 1) else NA_character_,
         character(1))
}

read_export <- function(path) {
  d <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"),
                check.names = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  names(d) <- make.names(gsub("[^ -~]", "", names(d)))   # drop byte-order mark
  d
}

ym_date <- function(x) as.Date(ifelse(is.na(x), NA, paste0(x, "-01")), format = "%Y-%m-%d")

prep_deid <- function(path) {
  read_export(path) %>%
    mutate(
      id               = ID,
      patient          = NA_character_,
      plan_raw         = NA_character_,
      referral_date    = ym_date(referral_month),
      eval_date        = ym_date(eval_month),
      committee_date   = ym_date(committee_month),
      multi_organ      = as.logical(multi_organ),
      closed_insurance = reason %in% INSURANCE
    )
}

load_any <- function(path) {
  cols <- names(read_export(path)[0, ])
  if ("referral_month" %in% cols) return(prep_deid(path))
  if ("Referral.Date" %in% cols)  return(prep_data(path))
  stop("This file doesn't look like the referral export or a de-identified file from deidentify.R.")
}

prep_data <- function(path) {
  d <- read_export(path)
  today <- Sys.Date()

  # DOB: fix 2-digit years R pushed into the future (2055 -> 1955)
  dob <- mdy2(d$DOB)
  fut <- !is.na(dob) & dob > today
  dob[fut] <- as.Date(format(dob[fut], "19%y-%m-%d"))

  committee_raw <- d$Committee.Decisions.Dates
  committee     <- last_line(committee_raw)          # keep latest decision
  committee     <- str_replace(committee, "Needs Re-presentation", "Deferred")

  d %>%
    mutate(
      MRN            = as.character(MRN),
      id             = MRN,
      patient        = Patient.Name,
      plan_raw       = Primary.Plan,
      referral_date  = mdy2(Referral.Date),
      eval_date      = mdy2(Eval.Start.Date),
      age            = as.numeric(referral_date - dob) / 365.25,
      payer          = clean_payer(Primary.Plan),
      coordinator    = str_extract(Coordinator, "^[^\n]+"),
      multi_organ    = !is.na(Organ) & Organ != "Kidney",
      reason         = Reason,
      status         = Status,
      closed_insurance = reason %in% INSURANCE,
      committee_decision = str_extract(committee, "^\\S+"),
      committee_date = as.Date(str_extract(committee, "\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}"),
                               format = "%m/%d/%Y"),
      phase_detail = case_when(
        !is.na(committee_raw) & str_detect(committee_raw, "Declined") ~ "Declined",
        Phase == "Referral" & Status == "Active"                     ~ "Referral-Active",
        Phase == "Referral" & Status %in% c("Closed", "Ineligible")  ~ "Referral-Closed",
        TRUE                                                         ~ Phase
      ),
      days_to_eval = as.numeric(eval_date - referral_date),
      days_open    = ifelse(phase_detail == "Referral-Active",
                            as.numeric(today - referral_date), NA_real_)
    )
}

# ------------------------------ helpers ------------------------------------

theme_qapi <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
          plot.title.position = "plot",
          legend.position = "top")
}

med_wk <- function(days) {
  if (all(is.na(days))) return("—")
  paste(round(median(days, na.rm = TRUE) / 7, 1), "wk")
}

week_hist <- function(days, xlab) {
  wk  <- days[!is.na(days) & days >= 0] / 7
  validate(need(length(wk) > 0, "No patients in this group for the current filters."))
  med <- median(wk)
  ggplot(data.frame(wk = wk), aes(wk)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = BLUE, color = "white") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = med, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("label", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.3,
             label = paste0("median: ", round(med, 1), " weeks  (n = ", length(wk), ")"),
             fill = "lightyellow", size = 4.5) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Patients") +
    theme_qapi()
}

age_hist <- function(age) {
  age <- age[!is.na(age)]
  validate(need(length(age) > 0, "No patients in this group for the current filters."))
  ggplot(data.frame(age = age), aes(age)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, boundary = 10, closed = "left",
                   fill = BLUE, color = "white") +
    labs(x = "Age at referral (years)", y = "Patients") +
    theme_qapi()
}

dt <- function(x, page = 15) {
  for (col in c("Patient", "Payer (raw)"))
    if (col %in% names(x) && all(is.na(x[[col]]))) x[[col]] <- NULL
  datatable(x, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            options = list(pageLength = page, scrollX = TRUE))
}

plot_card <- function(title, id, height = "420px") {
  card(full_screen = TRUE, card_header(title), plotOutput(id, height = height))
}

# -------------------------------- UI ---------------------------------------

ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "Kidney Transplant Referral QAPI",
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"),
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 300,
    fileInput("file", "Upload referral data (.csv)", accept = ".csv"),
    textOutput("data_info"),
    dateRangeInput("dates", "Referral date range"),
    selectizeInput("coord", "Coordinator", choices = NULL, multiple = TRUE,
                   options = list(placeholder = "All coordinators")),
    selectizeInput("payer", "Payer", choices = NULL, multiple = TRUE,
                   options = list(placeholder = "All payers")),
    checkboxInput("kidney_only", "Kidney-only (exclude multi-organ)", FALSE),
    numericInput("wait_wk", "Worklist: open referrals waiting ≥ (weeks)",
                 value = 8, min = 0, step = 1),
    downloadButton("dl", "Download filtered data")
  ),

  layout_column_wrap(
    width = "170px", fill = FALSE,
    value_box("Referrals",                  textOutput("kpi_n")),
    value_box("Active",                     textOutput("kpi_active")),
    value_box("Closed for insurance",       textOutput("kpi_ins")),
    value_box("Median referral → eval",     textOutput("kpi_t2e")),
    value_box("Median wait, open referrals", textOutput("kpi_wait")),
    value_box("Committee approved / declined", textOutput("kpi_comm"))
  ),

  navset_card_tab(
    nav_panel("Overview",
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(5, 7),
        plot_card("Where referrals are now", "p_phase"),
        plot_card("Referrals and evaluation starts by month", "p_monthly")
      )
    ),
    nav_panel("Insurance",
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(6, 6),
        plot_card("Referrals by payer", "p_payer", "520px"),
        plot_card("Share of each payer's referrals closed for insurance", "p_ins_rate", "520px")
      ),
      card(card_header("Referrals closed for insurance, by payer"), DTOutput("t_ins"))
    ),
    nav_panel("Closures",
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(7, 5),
        plot_card("Closure reasons (excluding insurance)", "p_reasons"),
        plot_card("Age of closed referrals (excluding insurance)", "p_closed_age")
      )
    ),
    nav_panel("Timing",
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(6, 6),
        plot_card("Referral → evaluation start (patients who reached evaluation)", "p_t2e"),
        plot_card("Open referrals: time waiting since referral", "p_wait")
      ),
      plot_card("Median weeks to evaluation, by month referred", "p_t2e_trend", "340px"),
      card(card_header("By coordinator"), DTOutput("t_coord"))
    ),
    nav_panel("Age",
      layout_columns(col_widths = c(4, 4, 4),
        plot_card("All referrals", "p_age_all", "340px"),
        plot_card("In evaluation", "p_age_eval", "340px"),
        plot_card("Declined at committee", "p_age_decl", "340px")
      )
    ),
    nav_panel("Committee",
      plot_card("Committee decisions by month", "p_committee"),
      card(card_header("Committee decisions"), DTOutput("t_committee"))
    ),
    nav_panel("Worklist",
      card(card_header(textOutput("worklist_title")), DTOutput("t_worklist"))
    ),
    nav_panel("Data",
      card(card_header("Filtered referrals"), DTOutput("t_data"))
    )
  )
)

# ------------------------------ server -------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  data_all <- reactive({
    validate(need(input$file, paste(
      "Upload KI_Referral_Details.csv (raw export) or KI_Referral_Deidentified.csv",
      "in the sidebar to begin. Your data stays in this browser and is not sent anywhere.")))
    load_any(input$file$datapath)
  })

  observeEvent(data_all(), {
    d   <- data_all()
    rng <- range(d$referral_date, na.rm = TRUE)
    updateDateRangeInput(session, "dates", start = rng[1], end = rng[2])
    updateSelectizeInput(session, "coord",
                         choices = sort(unique(na.omit(d$coordinator))), selected = character(0))
    updateSelectizeInput(session, "payer",
                         choices = sort(unique(d$payer)), selected = character(0))
  })

  output$data_info <- renderText({
    d <- data_all()
    rng <- range(d$referral_date, na.rm = TRUE)
    sprintf("%d referrals loaded, %s to %s", nrow(d),
            format(rng[1], "%b %d, %Y"), format(rng[2], "%b %d, %Y"))
  })

  df <- reactive({
    d <- data_all()
    if (length(input$dates) == 2 && !any(is.na(input$dates)))
      d <- filter(d, referral_date >= input$dates[1], referral_date <= input$dates[2])
    if (length(input$coord)) d <- filter(d, coordinator %in% input$coord)
    if (length(input$payer)) d <- filter(d, payer %in% input$payer)
    if (isTRUE(input$kidney_only)) d <- filter(d, !multi_organ)
    d
  })

  has_rows <- function(d) validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No referrals match the current filters."))

  # ---- KPIs
  output$kpi_n      <- renderText(nrow(df()))
  output$kpi_active <- renderText(sum(df()$status == "Active", na.rm = TRUE))
  output$kpi_ins    <- renderText({
    d <- df(); if (!nrow(d)) return("—")
    sprintf("%s (%d)", percent(mean(d$closed_insurance), 0.1), sum(d$closed_insurance))
  })
  output$kpi_t2e  <- renderText(med_wk(df()$days_to_eval[df()$days_to_eval >= 0]))
  output$kpi_wait <- renderText(med_wk(df()$days_open))
  output$kpi_comm <- renderText({
    dec <- df()$committee_decision
    sprintf("%d / %d", sum(dec == "Approved", na.rm = TRUE), sum(dec == "Declined", na.rm = TRUE))
  })

  # ---- Overview
  output$p_phase <- renderPlot({
    d <- df(); has_rows(d)
    ggplot(d, aes(x = phase_detail)) +
      geom_bar(fill = BLUE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = after_stat(count)), stat = "count", vjust = -0.4) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Referrals") +
      theme_qapi() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
  })

  output$p_monthly <- renderPlot({
    d <- df(); has_rows(d)
    m <- bind_rows(
      tibble(month = floor_date(d$referral_date, "month"), type = "Referrals"),
      tibble(month = floor_date(d$eval_date, "month"),     type = "Evaluations started")
    ) %>% filter(!is.na(month)) %>% count(month, type)
    ggplot(m, aes(month, n, fill = type)) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
      scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Referrals" = BLUE, "Evaluations started" = CORAL)) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = NULL,
           caption = "Evaluation starts are counted for the referrals in the current filter.") +
      theme_qapi()
  })

  # ---- Insurance
  output$p_payer <- renderPlot({
    d <- df(); has_rows(d)
    p <- count(d, payer)
    ggplot(p, aes(n, reorder(payer, n))) +
      geom_col(fill = BLUE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
      labs(x = "Referrals", y = NULL) +
      theme_qapi() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
                           panel.grid.major.x = element_line())
  })

  output$p_ins_rate <- renderPlot({
    d <- df(); has_rows(d)
    p <- d %>% group_by(payer) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), ins = sum(closed_insurance), rate = ins / n, .groups = "drop")
    ggplot(p, aes(rate, reorder(payer, rate))) +
      geom_col(fill = CORAL) +
      geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d / %d", ins, n)), hjust = -0.15, size = 3.8) +
      scale_x_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1.15), breaks = seq(0, 1, .25)) +
      labs(x = "Closed for insurance (% of that payer's referrals)", y = NULL) +
      theme_qapi() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
                           panel.grid.major.x = element_line())
  })

  output$t_ins <- renderDT({
    df() %>% filter(closed_insurance) %>%
      count(payer, name = "Closed for insurance", sort = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(`% of insurance closures` =
               percent(`Closed for insurance` / sum(`Closed for insurance`), 0.1)) %>%
      rename(Payer = payer) %>% dt(10)
  })

  # ---- Closures
  closed_other <- reactive({
    df() %>% filter(status != "Active", !closed_insurance, !is.na(reason))
  })

  output$p_reasons <- renderPlot({
    d <- closed_other(); has_rows(d)
    p <- count(d, reason)
    ggplot(p, aes(n, reorder(reason, n))) +
      geom_col(fill = BLUE) +
      geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.3) +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
      labs(x = "Closed referrals", y = NULL) +
      theme_qapi() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
                           panel.grid.major.x = element_line())
  })

  output$p_closed_age <- renderPlot(age_hist(closed_other()$age))

  # ---- Timing
  output$p_t2e  <- renderPlot(week_hist(df()$days_to_eval, "Weeks from referral to evaluation start"))
  output$p_wait <- renderPlot(week_hist(df()$days_open,    "Weeks since referral (still open)"))

  output$p_t2e_trend <- renderPlot({
    t <- df() %>% filter(!is.na(days_to_eval), days_to_eval >= 0) %>%
      mutate(month = floor_date(referral_date, "month")) %>%
      group_by(month) %>%
      summarise(med = median(days_to_eval) / 7, n = n(), .groups = "drop")
    validate(need(nrow(t) > 0, "No evaluations for the current filters."))
    ggplot(t, aes(month, med)) +
      geom_line(color = BLUE, linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(color = BLUE, size = 3) +
      geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), vjust = -1, size = 3.5) +
      scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
      labs(x = "Month referred", y = "Median weeks",
           caption = "Recent months look faster because slower referrals haven't reached evaluation yet.") +
      theme_qapi()
  })

  output$t_coord <- renderDT({
    df() %>% group_by(Coordinator = coordinator) %>%
      summarise(
        Referrals = n(),
        Active = sum(status == "Active", na.rm = TRUE),
        `Closed for insurance` = sum(closed_insurance),
        `Evals started` = sum(!is.na(eval_date)),
        `Median wk to eval` = round(median(days_to_eval[days_to_eval >= 0], na.rm = TRUE) / 7, 1),
        `Open referrals` = sum(phase_detail == "Referral-Active"),
        `Median wk waiting (open)` = round(median(days_open, na.rm = TRUE) / 7, 1),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Referrals)) %>% dt(10)
  })

  # ---- Age
  output$p_age_all  <- renderPlot(age_hist(df()$age))
  output$p_age_eval <- renderPlot(age_hist(df()$age[df()$phase_detail == "Evaluation"]))
  output$p_age_decl <- renderPlot(age_hist(df()$age[df()$phase_detail == "Declined"]))

  # ---- Committee
  output$p_committee <- renderPlot({
    cm <- df() %>% filter(!is.na(committee_date)) %>%
      count(month = floor_date(committee_date, "month"), committee_decision)
    validate(need(nrow(cm) > 0, "No committee decisions for the current filters."))
    ggplot(cm, aes(month, n, fill = committee_decision)) +
      geom_col() +
      scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Approved = BLUE, Declined = CORAL, Deferred = "gray60"),
                        na.value = "gray80") +
      labs(x = "Committee month", y = "Decisions", fill = NULL) +
      theme_qapi()
  })

  output$t_committee <- renderDT({
    df() %>% filter(!is.na(committee_decision)) %>%
      transmute(ID = id, Patient = patient, Coordinator = coordinator,
                Referred = referral_date, `Eval start` = eval_date,
                Decision = committee_decision, `Committee date` = committee_date,
                Age = round(age), Payer = payer) %>%
      arrange(desc(`Committee date`)) %>% dt()
  })

  # ---- Worklist
  output$worklist_title <- renderText(
    sprintf("Open referrals waiting %s+ weeks without an evaluation start", input$wait_wk))

  output$t_worklist <- renderDT({
    df() %>%
      filter(phase_detail == "Referral-Active", days_open / 7 >= input$wait_wk) %>%
      transmute(ID = id, Patient = patient, Coordinator = coordinator,
                Referred = referral_date, `Weeks waiting` = round(days_open / 7, 1),
                Payer = payer, `Payer (raw)` = plan_raw, Organ) %>%
      arrange(desc(`Weeks waiting`)) %>% dt(25)
  })

  # ---- Data + download
  output$t_data <- renderDT({
    df() %>%
      transmute(ID = id, Patient = patient, Organ, Coordinator = coordinator,
                Phase = phase_detail, Status = status, Reason = reason,
                Referred = referral_date, `Eval start` = eval_date,
                `Wk to eval` = round(days_to_eval / 7, 1),
                Committee = committee_decision, `Committee date` = committee_date,
                Age = round(age), Payer = payer) %>% dt()
  })

  output$dl <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() paste0("kidney_referrals_filtered_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
    content  = function(file) write.csv(df(), file, row.names = FALSE)
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
